name: FVCBankcorp, Inc.
summary: FVCBankcorp, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for FVCbank provides various banking products and services for small and medium-sized businesses, professionals, non-profit organizations and associations, and investors. The company provides various deposit products which includes interest and noninterest-bearing transaction accounts, certificates of deposit, savings, and money market accounts.
